record.body:
## Evidence

On a fresh load of a phase, requirement, needs, backlog or task deep link, Back goes to the first visible effort while the breadcrumb shows the route's effort.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Human: resolve the effort from the route (recommended), or accept the same behavior as main.
